chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Yahya al-Halabi, from Shu'ayb al-Haddad, from Yazid al-Sa'igh who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about women — do they inherit the real estate (riba')? He said: No, but they inherit the value of the building.

He said: I said: But the people are not pleased with this. He said: So he said: When we are placed in authority and the people are not pleased with that, we will strike them with the whip. If they do not comply, we will strike them with the sword.

key_terms.الرِّبَاع: Real estate, lands, or immovable property — specifically land that passes through inheritance
key_terms.الْبِنَاء: The building or structure erected on land, whose monetary value women inherit
key_terms.وُلِّينَا: When we are given authority/rule — referring to the political governance of the Imam

ai.seo_question: Do women inherit land (riba') in Shia Islam according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) issues a ruling on women's inheritance: women do not inherit land or real estate (al-riba'), but they do receive the monetary value of any structures built upon it. This ruling reflects the classical Shia jurisprudential position that protects the integrity of family lands while ensuring women receive fair compensation. When the narrator protests that people will reject this ruling, the Imam responds with a firm declaration of authority — that when the Imams rule, compliance with Islamic law will be enforced, even by physical means if necessary.
word_analysis: we are placed in authority/we rule

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Yahya Al Halby, from Shuayb Al Haddad, from Yazeed Al Saig who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the women, do they inherit the real estate? So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, but they inherit the value of the building’.

I said, ‘But the people are not pleased by that’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When we<sup>asws</sup> rule and the people are not pleased with that, we<sup>asws</sup> will strike them with the whip. So if they are not straightened (by that), we<sup>asws</sup> will strike them with the sword’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from Yahya al-Halabiy from Shu’ayb al-Haddad from Yazid al- Sa’igh who has narrated the following: “I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about women; if they inherit from the house. He (the Imam) said, ‘No, but they inherit from the value of the building.’
I (the narrator) then said, ‘People do not agree with it.’
He (the Imam) said, ‘When we will be in authority if people disagree we will use the sword and whip and if they will not behave properly we will strike them with the sword.’”
